Lore

[edit | edit source]

Merlin, the enigmatic sorcerer, is the architect of Arthur’s destiny and the driving force behind Camelot’s rise. His origins remain a mystery—some say he is a man, others a creature of the arcane. What is certain is his unmatched mastery of magic and prophecy. A collector of secrets and ancient knowledge, Merlin wields the elements with devastating power, bending fire, ice, and lightning to his will. Worshiped by scholars and mystics, Merlin embodies wisdom, foresight, and the unrelenting pursuit of order. On the battlefield, he stands as a terrifying force, wielding both his spells and his intellect to ensure victory. As Arthur’s closest ally, Merlin fights not for personal glory, but to see a world of peace and justice endure.

God Aspect

[edit | edit source]
Aspect of Pandemonium
Elemental Mastery has a reduced cooldown and each time it is used, a random Stance is selected with 2 random primary abilities, Flicker will always persist. Using Elemental Mastery provides an Intelligence buff for a short duration.
Aspect Enhanced Abilities (Click to Expand)
Ultimate - Elemental Mastery | RADIATE DAMAGE, RANDOM ABILITIES Notes:
  • On use, a random Stance is selected with 2 random primary abilities and you gain Intelligence for a short duration
  • After the explosion reaches its apex, it collapses in on itself dealing Magical Damage
  • Enemies suffer different effects depending on which stance's energy they are being hit by
  • Flicker will always remain, however, the effect it provides will be tied to the new Stance entered
  • Arcane: Enemies hit are Knocked Up
  • Fire: Enemies hit are afflicted by Radiate's Burn
  • Ice: Enemies hit are Slowed
  • Ability ranks are based off the ability's original ability group. Using a starting ability bar of a rank 3 Eclipse and a rank 1 Dragonfire as an example, generating Frostbolt and Radiate will give Merlin two rank 3 abilities, and then rerolling again and getting Vortex and Blizzard will give Merlin two rank 1 abilities.
